pageCache.pageTitle: Prep School In Kensington - Brighton College Prep Kensington
pageCache.text:
Introducing No. 58
We are delighted to announce that Brighton College Prep Kensington is expanding its campus! Known simply as No. 58, our stunning new building will be officially opened in just a few weeks and will provide a dedicated environment in which our oldest pupils can flourish during those important final years before they move on to their senior schools in Year 9.
Click on the video below to capture a glimpse of the innovative, ambitious, and inspiring experience that awaits them within the four walls of No. 58. You can’t argue with that!
WELCOME TO OUR SCHOOL
An independent school for boys and girls aged 2 to 13
As a part of the award-winning Brighton College family of schools, Brighton College Prep Kensington nurtures a culture of kindness, where the personal happiness of children is our priority. In an environment of academic excellence and opportunities beyond the classroom, we celebrate the uniqueness of every child, fostering curiosity and confidence as they grow.
Life in the Upper School
London is our Classroom
Our location in the heart of Kensington means we are able to use London as our classroom. Iconic London spaces such as the Natural History Museum, V&A, Hyde Park and the Science Museum are only a short walk away, offering a truly unique approach to education. With a beautiful Early Years Garden and two-acre Secret Garden, our pupils explore so much more than the traditional curriculum through outdoor learning and play.
Our Values
We provide opportunities for every child to excel, both inside and outside the classroom. Our stimulating environment develops pupils to be enthusiastic, energetic and kind – contagious qualities that enable a vibrant atmosphere to flourish.
Inspiring Curiosity
More than just teaching from a curriculum, the approach at Brighton College Prep Kensington is about helping children feel excited about the world around them. We know that education is for life, and curiosity is at the heart of a good education. We guide and encourage children to ask questions, enjoy the magic of discovery, work together to find solutions, and grow into adults who will make a real difference in the world. This is our priority with each and every child.
Building Confidence
We know how important it is for children to feel confident: to have that inner self-belief to try anything and be comfortable in their own skin. Whether they are an introvert, an extrovert, or neither, we believe in inspiring children to be a first-rate version of themselves and not a second-rate version of someone else.
"Brighton College: Where confidence, kindness and curiosity are championed."
A Culture of Kindness
Kindness is the currency at Brighton College. From learning about empathy in early years, to volunteering and working with community groups in older year groups, and partnering with international organisations to support global movements, our pupils are thoughtful and kind. We know that, more than academic results or sporting successes, this is what all parents want for their children.
Join us at an Open Morning At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.
Meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney
“I believe education needs to be exciting and dynamic to prepare pupils for the modern world. As teachers we should inspire children to explore, embrace opportunities and challenges, and work with others to be a part of society, not apart from it. Our curriculum nurtures academic excellence, but we know that learning needs to be fun and tailored to the individual needs of children. The happiness of each child matters above anything else at our school. Happy children excel, and the relationship between teachers, parents and children are at the forefront of our ethos. With a culture of kindness at the core of our school, and a firm belief in the individuality of each child, Brighton College Prep Kensington is a school where there are no limits to the dreams and aspirations of our children. Having held senior roles within three Brighton College prep schools, I bring a deep understanding of a Brighton College education, and I am delighted to be leading the school during such an exciting time in its history.”
United Kingdom School of the Decade
Brighton College was awarded the prestigious title of ‘United Kingdom School of the Decade’ by The Sunday Times and named 'one of the hottest tickets in independent education'. Brighton College Prep Kensington is the fourth Prep School in the UK family, and the ninth internationally. As a part of the leading co-educational school in the country, Brighton College Prep Kensington aims to become one of the leading preparatory schools in the world.
Your Child’s Journey
From arriving in the Nursery School all the way through to Year 8, a child’s journey with Brighton College Prep Kensington is remarkable. With our forward-thinking curriculum and innovative approach to education, our pupils are confident, resilient, academically curious and – most importantly – kind.
Discover More
Follow Us on Social Media
We had a hoot in Nursery School this morning! 🦉✨Our Nursery School children have been busy learning about the wonderful world of owls through the much loved story Owl Babies. Today, their learning came to life as we were lucky enough to welcome some special friends to the garden! ✨
Join us at our next Brighton College Prep Kensington Open Morning on Thursday 8th October. 💙 This is a whole school event, where you are able to tour our facilities, hear from our Head and see our fabulous school in action. To book your place, please visit the link in our bio!
This week, our Years 5 and 6 mixed Football team took part in the Grenfell Athletic Schools Cup. ⚽️The football tournament is a unique opportunity as it was set up by those directly affected by the Grenfell disaster to bring the community together and celebrate sport for young children. The team started strongly, winning five of their six group matches to finish top and qualify comfortably for the quarter finals. After three dominating performances, they secured an incredible 5-0 victory in the final to win the entire tournament! 👏🏽🏆It was a fantastic day, and we are incredibly proud of their achievement and sportsmanship.
From adventures in our new woodland garden to learning about ‘Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star’, it has been a busy few weeks in our Pre Nursery and Nursery School 💙⭐ To join our Nursery School Open Morning on Thursday 1 October please click the link in our bio.

pageCache.text:
Our Vision
An education which enables pupils to flourish
As a part of the Brighton College family of schools, Brighton College Prep Kensington prides itself on its forward-thinking curriculum and innovative approach to education, rooted in a culture of kindness. We are a school that encourages a love of learning for its own sake, helping children develop the knowledge and skills to prepare them for the future. We want them to be excited about the world beyond the classroom. We instil a firm belief that, at whatever age, we know we can make a real difference, locally and globally. This awareness of the needs of others means that Brighton College children respect and celebrate difference. Our purpose is to turn out happy, well-educated, kind and intellectually curious children who are ready to join the top senior schools in the country.
"Brighton College turns out good human beings, not just clever ones."
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.

Careers
Work with us
We are looking for dedicated and inspiring people to join our team. Brighton College Prep Kensington is a brand-new independent preparatory school opening in January 2023 for children aged 2-13 years. As part of the Independent School of the Decade (The Sunday Times), the Independent School of the Year 2019 (The Sunday Times) and Britain's Most Forward-Thinking School (The Week), Brighton College is a leading school in England. Located in Kensington, the College takes pride in employing talented individuals who wish to become part of our inclusive community. We are proud of our staff and the contribution they make to the life of the school, and we offer professional development in a stimulating environment.
"Brighton College: The sense of community makes everyone feel like they belong."
Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities
Brighton College is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Any offer of employment will be subject to an enhanced DBS disclosure, relevant original ID documentation and examination certificates. The College understands that a robust, fair and transparent recruitment and selection policy is central to achieving this aim. The College is committed to ensuring that the recruitment and selection of staff is conducted in a systematic, efficient and effective manner and promotes equality of opportunity.
Join our Team
To view and apply for our current vacancies please visit the Cognita Careers site below. We can't wait to hear from you!
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.

To request a copy of our prospectus, please share some basic information below.
Prep School In Kensington – Brighton College Prep Kensington

Nursery School
The Perfect Start
The Nursery School at Brighton College Prep Kensington is where children start their educational journey at two years old. Our Nursery School classes of Pre-Nursery (2+) and Nursery (3+) provide the perfect start for a journey of learning and discovery. Learning is brought to life through creative experiences that inspire lasting memories. From performances on the stage, to themed dress-up days, we foster an environment rich in imagination. Both the Early Years garden and the two-acre Secret Garden are the perfect locations to encourage imaginative play, whilst enabling children to put on their wellington boots and jump in puddles. The free flow nature of our classrooms have been carefully designed to extend learning within the classroom to the outdoors.
"Brighton College: One word: Exceptional."
Specialist Learning
Our expert Early Years team deliver a dynamic and engaging curriculum that captures a child's imagination, ensuring that each pupil receives the guidance and support they need to thrive academically and personally. Small classes, led by qualified teachers, allows us to get to know each child, ensuring they receive the highest level of individual attention to encourage growth and learning. Pupils in our Nursery School benefit from receiving lessons from our Prep School specialist teachers, meaning that French and Spanish are taught by our Languages department, Physical Education is delivered by professional coaches and Music by our Performing Arts specialists.
FAQs
When can my child start at Nursery School? Children typically join Pre-Nursery the September after they turn two and the Nursery the September they turn three. Occasionally, children may join the Pre-Nursery mid year once they have turned two. How do you prepare children for Reception? Our Early Years team follow the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) curriculum, enriched with our unique focus on creativity, wellbeing, independence whilst sparking a curiosity and love for learning. In preparation for Reception entry, children focus on pencil grip, early sound recognition, number identification and name writing. Entry to Reception at our school is subject to passing our Brighton College Prep Kensington Readiness Assessment.
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.

pageCache.pageTitle: Years 7 and 8 - Brighton College Prep Kensington
pageCache.text:
Upper School
Bespoke Curriculum
The Upper School is the culmination of a Brighton College Prep Kensington education, and proves to be a very rewarding experience for all our pupils as they make the most of the breadth of opportunities available to them. We offer a bespoke Brighton College curriculum throughout the final two years, preparing children for their move up to senior school. Pupils are also prepared for Common Entrance and Scholarship examinations at the end of Year 8.
Preparing for Senior School
With specialist teachers working with children throughout their prep school journey, and study skills, reasoning, current affairs and literacy practice incorporated into the timetable from Year 5 onwards, we ensure our children feel confident and happy as they prepare to move on to senior school. Our pupils leave us to attend Brighton College and other outstanding boarding schools and London day schools in the country. Our academic team work closely with parents to advise on senior school choices and to help prepare for pre-tests and interviews as required.
Outstanding Offers
This year, pupils received an outstanding 93 offers from over 40 schools with a whopping 13 children receiving offers to attend Brighton College. They will go onto some of the UK’s top boarding schools including Brighton College, Bradfield, Charterhouse, Cheltenham Ladies College, Downe House, Eton, Harrow, Marlborough, Sevenoaks, Wellington, Wycombe Abbey. Pupils also received offers to the finest London day schools including Alleyn's Hampstead, City of London Boys, City of London Girls, Francis Holland, Godolphin and Latymer, Harrodian, Ibstock, JAGS, Kew House, King's College School Wimbledon, Latymer, St Paul's Girls School, Thomas's College and Wetherby-Pembridge.
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.

pageCache.pageTitle: A Love Of Learning - Brighton College Prep Kensington
pageCache.text:
A Love of Learning
Creative and inspired way of teaching
We offer a rich curriculum that introduces pupils to creative and inspiring ways of teaching. Our teachers are enthusiastic experts in their subjects, dedicated to engaging children in their areas of expertise. Specialist teaching begins in Nursery, introducing pupils to a wide range of interesting and varied areas of learning: from Mandarin and music, to design, technology and dance.
Curious about the world around them
The root of education is curiosity, the perpetual search for answers, the constant asking of questions. We inspire our pupils to be curious about the world around them, now and always. Finding solutions for problems. Becoming adults who will make a real difference in whatever field they find themselves.
"Brighton College: Children are encouraged to achieve through exceptional teaching and pastoral care."
Preparing our pupils
The SUPER-Curriculum enrichment programme for Years 7 and 8 prepares our pupils for life at the next stage of their education. It provides opportunities for practical, skills-based learning, including debating, team-building, personal finances, online safety and study skills.
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.

pageCache.pageTitle: Pastoral Care & Wellbeing - Brighton College Prep Kensington
pageCache.text:
A Culture of Kindness
A CULTURE OF KINDNESS
We want our pupils to thrive and be happy
Kindness is at the heart of everything we do, and we place a great emphasis on teaching mutual respect and acceptance. Life at Brighton College Prep Kensington is defined by everyone feeling valued for who they uniquely are. In supporting children to develop their curiosity and love of learning, we help them grow into first-rate versions of themselves – not second-rate versions of someone else.
A Culture of Kindness
Along with preparing pupils for the top senior schools in the country through a programme of academic excellence and inspired learning, our pupils leave Brighton College as well-rounded, confident and kind individuals. Our pastoral system ensures every child feels supported, both academically and pastorally.
Preparing for Life
Our Personal, Social, Health and Economic Education (PSHEE) curriculum teaches children the skills and understanding they need to lead confident, healthy and independent lives. We ensure our pupils are provided with the knowledge and skills to be confident in making good decisions, regardless of what others may expect.
Partnership with Parents
We organise a range of informative seminars and workshops for parents to support their understanding of the latest educational questions. Guest speakers present on a range of relevant subjects, from social media and online safety to getting the most from revision.
Wellbeing
Spiritual, moral, social and cultural development is embedded within our school ethos. Many faiths are represented within the pupil body, with the principles of kindness and understanding underpinning all that we do. Children attend a rich schedule of assemblies inspired by a range of ideas, all of which reinforce our approach to curiosity, confidence and kindness.
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.
Next Steps
Prep School In Kensington – Brighton College Prep Kensington

Safeguarding
A Safe Place for Children
Brighton College Prep Kensington and its staff are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people under our care. We expect all staff, volunteers and visitors to share this commitment. Our policies create an open environment where staff and pupils feel able to raise concerns in the knowledge that they will be properly listened to, and where support services and other agencies will be involved as and when necessary. Everyone is expected to contribute to creating this culture of safeguarding.
Our Commitment to Safeguarding
The school's safeguarding policy will be reviewed at least annually by the Governing Body, unless events or regulatory changes require a more frequent review. Our safeguarding policies and procedures are consistent with the local authority procedures, and the DSL and Governing Body use the local authority audit tool to review policy and practice in the school every year.
The school will ensure that the welfare of children is given paramount consideration when developing and delivering all school activities:
Equal rights All children, regardless of age, gender, ability, culture, race, language, religion or sexual identity, have equal rights to protection: to feel safe, secure, valued, respected and confident, and know how to approach adults if they are facing difficulties. Responsibility It is everyone's responsibility to safeguard, protect and promote the welfare of children as part of their professional duties. Indeed, everyone who comes into contact with children and their families and carers has a role to play in safeguarding children. Policy All staff have an equal responsibility to act, in accordance with the Safeguarding Policy and procedures and KCSIE, on any suspicion, concern or disclosure that may suggest a child is in need of support services or is at risk of significant harm. The full version of KCSIE is available to all staff via the school intranet. Data protection The safety of a child is of the utmost importance, overriding any additional concerns, for example, relating to data protection or fears of sharing information.
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.

Admissions Process
1. Get in touch
We hope you will find all the information you need on these pages but, if not, our Admissions Team is here to help. The ideal way to learn more is to meet us in person and come along to one of our Open Mornings, which are held each term. Alternatively, if you would like to speak to a member of the Admissions Team, please complete our enquiry form, or get in touch directly by contacting us on 0207 591 4628.
2. Register
If you would like to apply for a place for your child, you will need to complete our online registration form. If you are interested in applying for a place for your child for entry in September 2026, please contact the Admissions Team. You can find more detailed information about each of our entry points, including what ages children are able to join us, below: Nursery (Age 2 to 4) Children may enter our Nursery from the age of 2. We recommend that parents register their child at least one year in advance of their proposed start date. Entrance to Nursery does not guarantee entry to 4+. Prep (Age 4-13) Our main intake is into our Reception classes, but there may be opportunities to join other year groups if places are available. Children can enter our Reception from their fourth birthday, which should fall on or before 31 August prior to starting.
3. Taster Days and Assessments
Nursery School Once registered, children who are 2+ will be invited to join our ‘stay and play’ sessions with their parents. This gives both you and your child the opportunity to get to know us a little better. It also makes it easier for children to settle if they take up a Nursery place with us, as they will be familiar with both the teachers and our setting. These sessions are overseen by the Head of Early Years and our Admissions team. Children who are offered a place are given a phased start to their time in Nursery School which is tailored to the individual child. Places are limited and will be offered on the basis of one of the following: 5 mornings, 5 afternoons or 5 full days. Our Nursery children show a readiness to thrive in our setting in terms of their communication and social skills and are happy to start their educational journey here. Places for Nursery School are limited. Prep After completing the registration process your child will be invited to attend an assessment day. This is the perfect opportunity to get to know one another better and to determine your child’s current academic levels. For entry into Year 1 upwards, the day will include standardised assessments in English, maths and reasoning. Please contact us for more information.
4. Offers and Welcome
If there is a space available, and we believe Brighton College Prep Kensington is the right school for your child, we will send you an offer letter shortly after assessment. Places for our Prep classes are normally offered at the end of January. Following your confirmation of acceptance, you will be sent an invitation to meet your child’s teacher and further information before the start of term.
Open Mornings
Our Open Mornings are the ideal way to see what Brighton College Prep Kensington is all about, for all entry points. Come and see our beautiful school, have a tour of the classrooms, wander through the two-acre Secret Garden and meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney. You will also meet our outstanding teachers and have an opportunity to ask any questions you may have.
Next Steps

Beyond the Classroom
BEYOND THE CLASSROOM
A World of Opportunities
We know that participation in the arts is vital in order to nurture the creativity, passion and individuality of each child. This complements the academic life of the school in a very special way. We encourage pupils to engage in a range of music, dance, art and drama as well as exploring and benefiting from our London location and all that our capital has to offer.
Performing Arts
Performing arts is the perfect way for our children to express themselves. Using drama, pupils explore their imagination through group participation. We encourage participation in the arts to foster creativity and individuality. This enlivens and energises their school life in a very special way. The drama department benefits from excellent facilities, including a spacious hall and a drama space with staging. All pupils have the opportunity to perform annually in plays directed by by our drama teacher, in which they can showcase their skills and talents. With the stages of London on our doorstep, the theatre is an important part of school life.
"Brighton College: One of the hottest tickets in independent education."
Creative Arts
Our art department is a truly imaginative environment for all our pupils. Specialist art teaching starts in Reception, where children are encouraged to express their own ideas and experiment with a wide variety of media, as well as to learn from the work of a wide range of artists through the ages. As pupils progress through the school, creativity and innovation continue to be fostered, drawing on a broad variety of techniques and skills. Our innovative Makerspace is a learning environment that allows children to arrive with an idea and leave with a completed project. The Makerspace emphasises hands-on discovery in a world that has become increasingly automated. As well as an abundance of craft and construction materials, the Makerspace features a range of technical equipment such as 3D printers, a laser cutter and sewing machines. Teachers carefully supervise pupils whilst they create amazing designs.
Sport for all
As part of Brighton College, one of the leading sporting schools in England, we are exceptionally well-equipped to introduce pupils to a variety of skills, nurturing sporting talent and awakening a love of sport and physical activity. We believe in offering a wide range of opportunities to all, whatever their ability. Specialist sports lessons begin in Reception with competitive play in Year 3, benefiting both high-achievers and the less confident. We focus on the key sports of football, netball, rugby, hockey, swimming, athletics and cricket, but there are also opportunities to get involved with additional sports such as basketball, gymnastics and badminton. Our location in Kensington means that we have a plethora of world-class sporting facilities on our doorstep. Year 3 and above have weekly swimming lessons at Imperial College next door and we regularly visit Hyde Park for sport lessons.
"The support from everyone at Brighton College was immense and gave me a massive opportunity to succeed in professional sport and beyond."
- MARCUS SMITH, ENGLAND AND HARLEQUINS RUGBY PLAYER
Clubs and Activities
Pupils can choose from a range of activities: from LAMDA to karate, and table tennis to cyber coding, there is an opportunity for every pupil to get involved in the rich co-curricular life of the school. Clubs are available to all ages from Nursery School through to Year 8, with registration at the beginning of each term. We take full advantage of our fantastic facilities on site, with Outdoor Learning visiting the Secret Garden to explore nature, cookery club in our designated cookery room, and construction club in our Makerspace.

pageCache.pageTitle: School Facilities & Location - Brighton College Prep Kensington
pageCache.text:
Our Spaces
A Beautiful London Setting
Our school is a beautiful, bright and friendly environment where pupils can learn and grow. All our spaces have been created to instil curiosity and develop a love of exploration and learning. We are located in the heart of Kensington, across four spacious Grade-II listed Victorian townhouses, which have been designed to a bespoke educational standard. Our proximity to museums and Hyde Park means that children truly experience London as a classroom. What also makes us so unique, however, is the beautiful two-acre Secret Garden tucked away behind our school, a hidden gem waiting to be explored!
Creative Spaces, Inspiring Imagination
We have rejected the outdated belief that children have to sit in straight lines on single desks and have created forward-thinking spaces that encourage academic learning, as well as collaboration and creativity. Our classrooms are more than simply functional: they use space, light and resources to inspire both teachers and pupils. Pupils enjoy access to classrooms, play areas, a state-of-the-art science lab, two art studios, a beautiful music room and our multi-purpose and bold Makerspace. Children buzz with excitement when they explore the Makerspace. From green-screen technology and 3D printing to craft and construction, this innovative environment enables our pupils to bring their ideas to life. We place an emphasis on practical projects to support children in learning beyond the curriculum, developing skills such as communication, collaboration and advanced problem solving.
The Secret Garden
The jewel in our crown is an inviting two-acre Secret Garden, tucked away behind the school. We believe it to be the largest of any Prep School in central London! The Secret Garden is set directly behind the school, with a magical path that connects the space to our own outdoor classroom. This access to outdoor space means that we are able to run a Forest School programme, emphasising outdoor learning and the importance of environmental responsibility. Come rain or shine, the outdoors is an integral part of daily life at Brighton College Prep Kensington. Children enjoy fun, hands-on, practical experiences as a part of the curriculum throughout the year. By using the garden as an extension of the classroom, we help our pupils develop enquiring minds and nurture their curiosity about the greater world around them.
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.
Sporting Life
Pupils use the fantastic on-site facilities including our garden areas and the main school hall for sports and games. As pupils progress through the school, they take part in games off-site. Children go next door to Imperial College where they enjoy use of the Ethos Centre, including the sports hall and the swimming pool. PE lessons take place at Imperial College Beit Sports Hall, a short 5-minute walk from school. We also make full use of the expansive fields at Hyde Park throughout the year!
"The support from everyone at Brighton College was immense and gave me a massive opportunity to succeed in professional sport and beyond."
- MARCUS SMITH, ENGLAND AND HARLEQUINS RUGBY PLAYER
World-Class Facilities
Where to find us
Brighton College Prep Kensington is the perfect central London location being a 10-minute walk from both South Kensington and Knightsbridge tube station. Victoria Station is 15 minutes away by public transport. We also run a bus service available from Year 1, complete with chaperone, for morning drop-off and afternoon pick-up dependent on demand. Our Family of Schools
OUR FAMILY OF SCHOOLS
Opening the door to a global learning community
Brighton College Prep Kensington is proud to be part of Cognita, a diverse global community of over 100 schools that share one common purpose: to enable students to thrive in a rapidly evolving world. Cognita schools achieve this by providing an outstanding holistic education that delivers the best academic outcomes for each and every student. A balanced combination of cognitive, social, emotional and physical learning, alongside rich learning opportunities, also helps students to develop agency, adaptability and positive attitudes – skills that are required to thrive in life.
"Brighton College: a true centre of excellence in all things."
At our Open Mornings you will have the opportunity to meet our Head, Mrs Lois Gaffney, and other key members of staff, and learn more about what a Brighton College education looks like.
